bullets.text: A lawyer has challenged the Supreme Court's de-notification of Jantar Mantar as a protest site.
The Supreme Court questioned a man seeking bail in an assault case, asking, 'You ate his ear off, how do we replace it?'
India's gem and jewellery exports rose 9.43% year-on-year in September, driven by demand for studded gold jewellery and lab-grown diamonds.
Tata Technologies reported a 4% YoY profit increase to Rs 171 crore, with revenue rising 28% to Rs 1,699 crore in Q2.
Ten Nifty 500 stocks have fallen between 47% and 58% over the past year, significantly underperforming the broader market.
